## Wave 8 Summary

This wave attacks Q33 — the `§VII.AJ.STATE-PROJ derivation` open question — along the **productive Track-A path** that sidesteps the no-A-sector obstruction identified in the S116-W7 algebra-axis workshop (volovik × landau). That workshop resolved the COLLAPSE-vs-ORTHOGONAL tension as a Level-1 (identity) vs Level-3 (value-provenance) conflation: STATE-PROJ = `ρ_BCS(P·H)` is an algebra-DEPENDENT **Corner III** state-pair functional, structurally ORTHOGONAL to the algebra-INVARIANT **Corner I** OP-PROJ spectrum-only count `R_∞ ≈ −1.892`. The Level-3 anchor for STATE-PROJ was HELD **Track-B** (lab-fed: the `+0.035356` value IS `R_3HeB_lit`, sourced from the 3He A/B strong-coupling ratio `SC_A/SC_B`, with `substrate_first_SC_ratio_available = False`). The literal A/B form is structurally blocked: the fabric realizes only the BW-like (BDI, N₃=0, fully gapped) manifold — there is no intrinsic 3He-A (ABM/axial, DIII, N₃=2) sector, hence no substrate `Δ_A` (registry status: `REGISTRY-INCOMPLETE-PENDING-FIRST-EXTRACTION`).

The inter-summand route **sidesteps** this: instead of asymmetry between A/B *phases the substrate does not carry*, it computes the asymmetry between the **two algebra summands the substrate DOES carry** — ℍ (quaternion, SU(2)_L weak-isospin) and M₃(ℂ) (color SU(3)_c) of `A_K = ℂ ⊕ ℍ ⊕ M₃(ℂ)` — at the **COMMON** substrate gap `Δ_BCS`. Because the gap is common, the condensation weight `a = ½N(0)Δ²` divides out the `Δ_BCS²`, leaving `R_summand` as the pure **gap-edge density-of-states asymmetry** between the summands. This is Track-A-eligible: NO lab SC ratio is injected; the only inputs are the substrate's own `A_K` central projections (from S116-W5-BIMODULE-H) and the D_K spectrum.

- **8-1 `CF-S117-STATEPROJ-INTER-SUMMAND`** [productive Track-A; `[SIGN]`] — the FIRST-EXTRACTION test. A composite gate G1∧G2 (G1 = `R_summand` computed substrate-first / G2 = sign+magnitude reported with the inter-summand Corner-III interpretation). PASS discharges the held credential to fully substrate-first; a structural vanish (R≈0) is an **informative FAIL** (the corridor yields no substrate-first instance either — an honest risk, not foregone).
- **8-2 `CF-S117-STATEPROJ-OPSTATE-COVARIATION`** (CF-W7-1) [OPTIONAL, LOW; `[VERIFY]`] — a numerical bound on the residual OP-PROJ ↔ STATE-PROJ co-variation under {ξ_k}/L_max/τ-moduli deformation. Both W7 agents agree the partial-collapse residual is BENIGN; this gate puts a NUMBER on it. NOT an adjudication.

**Standing gap (NOT a wave gate)**: `CF-S117-STATEPROJ-SC-FROM-SUBSTRATE` (the literal A/B form from substrate strong-coupling corrections) is HIGH-RISK structurally-blocked (single BDI, N₃=0, no intrinsic 3He-A sector ⇒ no substrate `Δ_A`). It is recorded as a standing gap in `session-117-context.md §"Standing gaps"` and is **NOT planned here**.

```yaml
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "R_summand = (a_ℍ − b_{M₃})/(a_ℍ + b_{M₃}) is sign-definite with predicted R_summand > 0

                  ⇒ |w_k| is PH-EVEN (depends only on |ξ_k|) and GAP-LOCALIZED (peaks at the gap edge).
    Definition 4: a_ℍ = Σ_{k∈ℍ}|w_k| / N_ℍ = ρ_ℍ(|w|) ;  b_{M₃} = Σ_{k∈M₃}|w_k| / N_{M₃} = ρ_{M₃}(|w|)
                  (intensive state evaluation, RATIO-NORMALIZED-TRACE-MEAN; N_summand = Tr(P_summand-on-fiber),
                   the W5 central projection ranks lifted to the D_K fiber).
    Definition 5: R_summand = (a_ℍ − b_{M₃})/(a_ℍ + b_{M₃}).

    Substitute (positivity of denominator):
        |w_k| > 0 for every mode with ξ_k finite (w_k = −Δ_BCS/2 at ξ=0, → 0⁺ only as |ξ|→∞).
        a_ℍ > 0 and b_{M₃} > 0 (sums of positive |w_k| over nonempty summand mode-sets).
        ⇒ a_ℍ + b_{M₃} > 0.

    Simplify (sign):
        sign(R_summand) = sign(a_ℍ − b_{M₃}) = sign(⟨|w|⟩_ℍ − ⟨|w|⟩_{M₃}).

    Non-triviality (why R is NOT forced to 0 — the vanishing-test logic):
        Counterfactual: had the functional been the bare BdG occupation v_k² = ½(1 − ξ_k/E_k),
        then v²(ξ) + v²(−ξ) = 1, so ⟨v²⟩ over any PH-symmetric mode-set = ½ EXACTLY ⇒ a = b = ½
        ⇒ R_summand ≡ 0 (TRIVIAL VANISH, symmetry-forced). The condensation weight |w_k| is PH-EVEN,
        |w(ξ)| = |w(−ξ)|, so it does NOT average to a ξ-independent constant — it integrates the
        gap-edge DENSITY OF STATES. Therefore R_summand ≠ 0 IFF the ℍ and M₃ summands have
        DIFFERENT gap-edge condensation density: ⟨|w|⟩_ℍ ≠ ⟨|w|⟩_{M₃}, equivalently N_ℍ(0) ≠ N_{M₃}(0)
        (since at common Δ_BCS the leading weight is ½N_summand(0)·Δ_BCS² and the Δ_BCS² cancels in
        the ratio, leaving the pure DOS asymmetry). This is the G1 vanishing test; its outcome is the
        HONEST RISK (a structural N_ℍ(0)=N_{M₃}(0) gives R=0, an informative FAIL — NOT foregone).

    Direction (predicted, falsifiable; the sign is the genuine OUTPUT):
        Structural DOS expectation — the M₃(ℂ) summand (the larger color algebra, central-projection
        rank 18 vs ℍ rank 4 in the W5 bimodule) distributes its modes over more of the fiber rep
        content, spreading M₃-spectral-weight to larger |ξ| (away from the gap edge), LOWERING its
        intensive gap-localized density ⟨|w|⟩_{M₃}; the smaller ℍ (weak-isospin) summand concentrates
        its fewer modes nearer the gap edge, RAISING ⟨|w|⟩_ℍ. ⇒ a_ℍ > b_{M₃} ⇒ R_summand > 0.
        This prediction is a structural EXPECTATION, not a certainty: the intensive average depends on
        the summand-RESOLVED |ξ| distribution set by the D_K fiber coupling, which is the compute output.

    Conclusion: R_summand = (⟨|w|⟩_ℍ − ⟨|w|⟩_{M₃})/(⟨|w|⟩_ℍ + ⟨|w|⟩_{M₃}); predicted > 0; sign is the
        reported OUTPUT (sign_verdict DIAGNOSTIC); the binding gate hypothesis is the vanishing test
        (|R| ≥ ε_vanish, G1) + Corner-III stability (G2). A sign opposite to the prediction is informative
        (the substrate DOS runs opposite to the algebra-rank expectation) and does NOT, by the plan-frozen
        composite-precedence below, collapse the composite to FAIL.

  the substrate's OWN algebra central projections P_ℍ, P_{M₃} of A_K=ℂ⊕ℍ⊕M₃(ℂ) → the inter-summand
  asymmetry R_summand. This is a Corner-III (algebra-DEPENDENT) STATE-PROJ observable: it reads the
  substrate's condensate weighted against its intrinsic algebra summands, NOT a laboratory-IN
  measurement of a 3He cell. The 3He-B cell is a projection OF the substrate, not its source — and
  the no-A-sector block is sidestepped because ℍ and M₃ are summands the substrate genuinely carries
  (unlike the 3He-A/ABM manifold it does not). If R_summand ≠ 0, the substrate commits a STATE-PROJ
  value with ZERO lab input — the precise sense in which it passes the vanishing test (S116-W7) and
  becomes substrate-first.
```

## Wave 8 → Wave 9 Decision Point

Wave 8 is **terminal** for the landau-owned thread and does NOT feed Wave 9 (mack e-fold substrate obligations consume A_s/flatness inputs, not the STATE-PROJ slot). The branching is on the §VII.AJ.STATE-PROJ registry slot only:

| 8-1 outcome | Solution-map consequence | Routing |
|:------------|:-------------------------|:--------|
| **PASS** (\|R_summand\| ≥ 1e-3 ∧ Corner-III-stable, Track-A) | §VII.AJ.STATE-PROJ DISCHARGES `REGISTRY-INCOMPLETE-PENDING-FIRST-EXTRACTION` → substrate-first (Track A); the S116-W7 held credential becomes fully substrate-committed | mack updates the §VII.AJ.STATE-PROJ slot status (sole writer); atlas-08 Q33 → answered-substrate-first. A session-end housekeeping item, NOT a new compute. |
| **FAIL** (\|R_summand\| < 1e-6, structural vanish) | inter-summand corridor CLOSED; route yields no substrate-first instance; slot stays `REGISTRY-INCOMPLETE-PENDING-FIRST-EXTRACTION` with the Track-B Level-3 anchor held; no-A-sector block NOT sidestepped | Q33 stays open; record the vanish as the informative boundary (the ℍ/M₃ gap-edge DOS are equal). No further inter-summand CF (the corridor is closed-with-result). |
| **INFO** (marginal \|R\| OR Corner-III-unstable) | value recorded; slot stays PENDING | refinement CF (tighten L_max ≥ 14 / re-examine gap-localization) — a genuine forward compute if the value is borderline. |

| 8-2 outcome | Consequence | Routing |
|:------------|:------------|:--------|
| **PASS** (C_covar < 0.5) | Level-1 orthogonality numerically robust under deformation; partial-collapse residual benign | low-leverage annotation on the algebra-axis 4-corner registry; no status change. |
| **INFO / FAIL** (C_covar ≥ 0.5) | co-movement larger than ideal; Level-1 identity orthogonality UNAFFECTED | record the bound + detrended diagnostic; note the co-monotonic-deformation caveat. |

If BOTH gates close PASS/INFO, the landau thread is complete; no Wave-8-sourced carry-forward propagates except a PASS-conditional mack slot-status housekeeping item (§A) and any 8-1-INFO refinement CF (§B).
